    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AI开发-python-langchain框架（3-2-文本文档加载器 ）</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>上节讲如何将文本进行向量化，本节讲讲如何将文本文件加载到程序中，进行下一步处理，langchain 的 TextLoader提供了这个功能。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>langchain 的 TextLoader <strong style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">并非支持所有文本格式</strong>，它的核心作用是读取「纯文本类文件」，对非纯文本格式（如带格式的文档、二进制文件）无法直接解析，需搭配对应专用 Loader。</p>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">一、TextLoader 支持的主要文本类型（可直接读取）</h3>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<ol style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">纯文本文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.txt</code>（最常用，无任何格式，直接读取文本内容）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">简单标记 / 配置文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.md</code>（Markdown，仅读取文本内容，忽略格式标记）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.json</code>（读取完整文本字符串，不解析 JSON 结构）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.yaml</code>/<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.yml</code>（同 JSON，仅读取文本，不解析配置）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">代码文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.py</code>（Python 代码）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.java</code>、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.js</code> 等，读取代码文本内容（不执行、不解析代码逻辑）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">其他纯文本类文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.csv</code>（读取为纯文本，不解析表格结构）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.log</code>（日志文件，纯文本形式直接读取）。</li>
</ol>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">二、TextLoader 不支持的文本格式（需专用 Loader）</h3>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">以下格式无法用 TextLoader 直接读取，需使用 langchain 对应专用 Loader（如 UnstructuredLoader、PyPDFLoader 等）：</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<ul style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">带格式文档：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.docx</code>（Word）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.pptx</code>（PPT）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.xlsx</code>（Excel）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">PDF 文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.pdf</code>（需用 PyPDFLoader、PDFMinerLoader 等）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">二进制文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.png</code>（图片）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.mp3</code>（音频）、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.mp4</code>（视频）；</li>
<li style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: list-item; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">加密 / 压缩文件：<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.zip</code>、<code style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; text-align: left; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">.rar</code>、加密文档等。</li>
</ul>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">三、关键补充</h3>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">TextLoader 的核心逻辑是「按字符读取文件内容」，无论文件后缀是什么，只要是<strong style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: bold 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: inline; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">纯文本编码（UTF-8、GBK 等）</strong> 的文件，都能读取；但如果文件包含非文本编码（如二进制、特殊格式标记），读取后会出现乱码，失去实际意义。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">简单总结：TextLoader 只适用于「无复杂格式的纯文本类文件」，复杂格式需搭配对应专用 Loader。</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">&nbsp;</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">代码部分：</div>
<div style="color: rgba(31, 35, 41, 1); font: 400 16px / 24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, &quot;Apple Color Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Emoji&quot;, &quot;Segoe UI Symbol&quot;, &quot;Noto Color Emoji&quot;; text-align: start; white-space: normal; display: block; flex: 0 1 auto; flex-direction: row; padding: 0; margin: 0; background: none">
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;"># pip install unstructured  # 安装unstructured库，用于处理非结构化文档

from langchain_community.document_loaders import TextLoader, DirectoryLoader, JSONLoader
import os

# ==================== 获取当前文件路径 ====================
# os.path.abspath(__file__) 获取当前脚本的绝对路径
# os.path.dirname() 获取路径的目录部分
current_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
print('---------当前路径')
print(current_dir)  # 打印当前脚本所在的目录路径

# ==================== 加载单个TXT文件 ====================
print('---------txt文件加载')
# TextLoader: 用于加载文本文件的加载器
# "./txt/1.txt": 相对路径下的txt文件
# encoding="utf8": 指定文件编码为UTF-8，防止中文乱码
loader = TextLoader("./txt/1.txt", encoding="utf8")
doc = loader.load()  # load()方法执行实际的文件读取操作
print(doc)  # 打印加载的文档内容

# ==================== 加载单个HTML文件 ====================
print('---------html文件加载')
# 虽然文件是HTML格式，但TextLoader会将其作为纯文本读取
loader1 = TextLoader("./txt/Color-management.html", encoding="utf8")
doc1 = loader1.load()
print(doc1)

# ==================== 目录加载器 ====================
# Windows系统需要先安装: pip install python-magic-bin
# Linux系统需要先安装: pip install python-magic
print('---------目录加载器 一个目录下所有文件加载')
# DirectoryLoader: 用于加载整个目录下的所有文件
# './file': 指定要加载的目录路径
# 默认会加载目录下的所有文件（包括子目录）
loader = DirectoryLoader('./file')
texts = loader.load()  # 加载目录中的所有文件
print(texts)  # 打印所有加载的文档

# ==================== 使用glob参数筛选特定文件 ====================
print('---------我们可以使用 glob 参数来控制加载哪些文件。请注意，此处它只加载.json 文件。')
# DirectoryLoader 的高级用法：
# glob="**/*.json": 使用glob模式匹配所有.json文件
#   ** 表示任意层级的子目录
#   *.json 表示所有以.json结尾的文件
# loader_cls=TextLoader: 指定使用TextLoader来加载匹配到的文件
# loader_kwargs={'encoding': 'gbk'}: 传递给TextLoader的参数，指定使用GBK编码
#   因为有些JSON文件可能使用GBK编码（常见于中文Windows系统）
loader = DirectoryLoader(
    './txt',  # 要扫描的根目录
    glob="**/*.json",  # 只加载JSON文件
    loader_cls=TextLoader,  # 使用文本加载器
    loader_kwargs={'encoding': 'gbk'}  # 指定编码为GBK
)
josntxt = loader.load()  # 加载所有匹配的JSON文件
print(josntxt)  # 打印加载的JSON文件内容
</pre>
</div>
<p>执行结果：</p>
<p>D:\ProgramData\Anaconda3\envs\llm\python.exe D:/pythonProject2025/LLmProject/3/2-文本文档加载器.py<br>---------当前路径<br>D:\pythonProject2025\LLmProject\3<br>---------txt文件加载<br>[Document(page_content='&nbsp; &nbsp; 文本切割是自然语言处理中的基础操作，主要用于将较长的文本内容拆解为更小的、可处理的单......<br>---------html文件加载<br>[Document(page_content='&lt;!DOCTYPE html&gt;\n&lt;html lang="zh"&gt;\n\n&lt;head&gt;\n\t&lt;meta charset="utf-8"&gt;\n\t&lt;base href=".....<br>---------目录加载器 一个目录下所有文件加载<br>[Document(page_content='文本切割是自然语言处理中的基础操作，主要用于将较长的文本内容拆解为更小的、可处理的单元，....<br>---------我们可以使用 glob 参数来控制加载哪些文件。请注意，此处它只加载.json 文件。<br>[Document(page_content='{\n\t"code": 200,\n\t"success": true,\n\t"obj": {\n\t\t"dataList": [\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\t....<br><br></p>
